name: Poha with Peanuts
ingredients: flattened rice; peanuts; mustard seeds; onion; green chili; curry leaves; turmeric; lemon juice
instructions: Rinse poha. Sauté mustard seeds, peanuts, onions, and curry leaves in oil. Add poha and turmeric; steam 3 mins with lemon juice.

name: Upma Rava
ingredients: roasted semolina; mustard seeds; chana dal; cashews; onion; ginger; green chili; ghee
instructions: Sauté spices, cashews, and veggies in ghee. Add boiling water, gradually whisk in rava, cover and steam 5 min.

name: Oatmeal with Honey & Fruits
ingredients: rolled oats; milk/almond milk; honey; sliced banana; chia seeds; blueberries
instructions: Simmer oats in milk for 5 mins. Pour into bowl; top with sliced bananas, berries, chia seeds, and honey drizzle.

name: French Toast Classic
ingredients: bread slices; egg; milk; cinnamon; butter; maple syrup
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk and cinnamon. Dip bread slices in egg mix and toast on buttered skillet until golden.

name: Omelette Masala
ingredients: eggs; onion; tomato; green chili; cilantro; butter; black pepper
instructions: Whisk eggs with finely chopped onions, tomatoes, and chilies. Pour onto hot buttered pan; fold and serve hot.

name: Paneer Bhurji
ingredients: crumbled paneer; onion; tomato; cumin; turmeric; chili powder; butter
instructions: Sauté onions and tomatoes with spices. Add crumbled paneer; toss for 3 minutes until aromatic and tender.

name: Egg Burrito
ingredients: scrambled eggs; tortilla; cheddar cheese; salsa; avocado; black beans
instructions: Scramble eggs. Warm tortilla, fill with eggs, cheese, black beans, salsa, and sliced avocado; roll tightly.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
ingredients: grilled chicken breast; romaine lettuce; caesar dressing; parmesan; flour tortilla
instructions: Toss grilled chicken slices with romaine lettuce, caesar dressing, and parmesan. Wrap tightly in tortilla.

name: Greek Salad with Feta
ingredients: cucumber; tomato; kalamata olives; red onion; feta cheese; extra virgin olive oil; oregano
instructions: Chop cucumber, tomatoes, and onions into chunks. Combine with olives, top with feta block, drizzle olive oil & oregano.

name: Lentil Dahl Soup
ingredients: red lentils; coconut milk; onion; garlic; turmeric; cumin; spinach
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic with turmeric and cumin. Add red lentils and water; simmer until soft. Stir in coconut milk & spinach.
